app.name: HydroSight
app.tagline: Flood risk intelligence and early warning
status.title: Platform status
status.foundations: Sign-in, roles and the audit trail are in place. No live data, sensors or forecasts are connected yet.
community.title: Community flood reports
community.area.none: No area is accepting community reports yet.
risk.title: Local flood risk
risk.none: Flood risk has not been assessed for your area yet. This does not mean there is no risk.
report.intro: Tell your area what you see. Your report is shown as an unverified community report until a moderator checks it.
report.kind.label: What are you reporting?
report.depth: Water depth in cm (optional, your own estimate)
report.photo.note: Photos are shrunk on your phone and location data inside the photo is removed.
report.photo.failed: This photo could not be used. Try another one.
report.location.none: No location yet. Use your location or type it in.
report.location.denied: Location is switched off for this site. Type the place in, or allow location in your browser settings.
report.anonymous: Report anonymously (nothing about you is stored)
report.signedin: Signed in: your report is linked to your account so you can withdraw it.
report.consent: I agree that HydroSight stores this report, including the location I share, so the people responsible for my area can see it. Anonymous reports cannot be removed later because they are not linked to me.
report.saved.offline: Saved on this phone. It will be sent when you are back online.
report.sent: Report sent. It shows as unverified until a moderator checks it.
report.queue.title: Waiting to send
report.queue.empty: Nothing is waiting to be sent.
report.problem.consent: Please agree to the statement above to send a report.
report.problem.time: The time must be within the last 14 days and not in the future.
report.problem.depth: Depth must be between 0 and 1000 cm.
warnings.title: Warnings near you
warnings.none: No public warnings are published right now. This does not mean there is no flood risk.
warnings.signin: Sign in to confirm or dispute a warning.
warnings.feedback.note: Your answer goes to the team that issued the warning. It does not change the warning.
warnings.feedback.thanks: Thank you. Your answer was recorded.
help.title: Safe places and emergency information
help.none: Nobody has published safe places or emergency information for this area yet. In an emergency call your local emergency number.
settings.pending: This translation is waiting for a human reviewer. Some text may appear in English.
settings.alerts.note: SMS and push alerts are not switched on yet. Warnings appear on this page only.
settings.install: Install this app: open your browser menu and choose Add to Home screen.
net.offline: You are offline. Reports are saved here and sent later.
mod.title: Community moderation
